name: LLM setup (app.tab.ready)
description: Runs the LLM setup wizard every time a UI tab finishes loading — every app start, reload or new window: checks Python 3, Git, Node.js and npm, and asks before installing any that is missing. Nothing is asked when everything is installed. Deliberately NOT fire_once: a tool removed later, or a question cancelled, is asked about again on the next load.
